Hadhrat Muhammad bin Ka'b Qurazi narrates that Hadhrat Ali bin Abi Taalib (RA) once said, "It never occurs that Allaah opens the door of gratitude and closes the door of increasing bounties. It also never occurs that Allaah opens the door of du'aa and closes the door of acceptance. Similarly, it never occurs that Allaah opens the door of Taubah and closes the door of forgiveness. I shall recite this from Allaah's Book. Allaah says:
"Supplicate (make du'aa) to Me and I shall respond."
"If you show gratitude (for the favours I grant you), then I will definitely grant you (many) more."
"So think of Me and I will think of you."

blocks.text: Whoever commits a (minor) sin or wrongs himself (by committing a major sin) and then seeks Allaah's forgiveness, he will surely find that Allaah is Most Forgiving, Most Merciful."[^2]
The Statements of Hadhrat Abu Dardaa (RA), Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA) and Hadhrat Asmaa (RA) Concerning Gratitude

Hadhrat Abu Dardaa (RA) said, "When a night or a day passes without people seeing me suffer any difficulty, I see this as an extremely great bounty from Allaah." Another narration quotes him as saying, "The person who sees Allaah's bounties only in food and drink has a limited understanding and has his punishment ever present."[^3]
